subject.title: fix(agents): avoid symlink-follow in auth.json bootstrap

question: Should this PR be allowed to land as auth bootstrap symlink hardening while the reused atomic helper still chmods the final path by name after rename?
rationale: This is a security-boundary judgment because the PR improves the static symlink case but leaves an active parent-directory attacker race unless the helper or usage is hardened.

options.title: Harden before merge
options.body: Require the PR to set permissions on the temp file before rename or verify/chmod the final file without following symlinks, plus add proof for the active race path.

options.title: Accept narrower scope
options.body: Merge only if maintainers explicitly accept that this fixes the pre-planted dangling-symlink case and track active symlink-swap hardening separately.

options.title: Move to fs-safe hardening
options.body: Pause this PR and fix the post-rename chmod contract in `@openclaw/fs-safe` first if maintainers want the primitive hardened for all callers.

recommendation.title: Harden before merge
recommendation.body: Require the PR to set permissions on the temp file before rename or verify/chmod the final file without following symlinks, plus add proof for the active race path.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is security-sensitive agent auth behavior, which matches the listed Agents/Security ownership area and CODEOWNERS secops routing.
